plugins.description: One agent skill for academic research, powered by Agent Bayes. It works at the size you ask, from a cited answer about the literature to a full paper from a seed idea: corpus building, literature reviews and gaps, positioning, study design and analyses, writing, review, and typesetting, with every literature claim carrying a verified page-level citation.
